notes: R214 deployment (run_state_policy.py). Gains, scale and payload match training / the R187 sysid setup. Limits are our safety stops, not training settings: wrist box = R214 sim rollout wrist range + margin; min wrist height 0.11 m above the table (training minimum 0.133 m); start pose must be within 0.45 rad (joint-space L2) of a training start (R217 banks, leave-one-out p99). Speed stops: R214 moves up to ~1 m/s in sim (R220 p99 per-step motion 64-102 mm); lower them for cautious first runs. Cube ages: the bottom cube is static (2 s), a free carried cube must be re-detected within 0.5 s, a held cube is propagated with the wrist (latency_compensation) for up to 3 s. start_joint_positions_rad (for move_to_start.py only) = medoid of the R217 Reaching-bank starts, (28.2, -131.8, -119.2, -110.9, -137.7, 93.3) deg, wrist 0.45 m above the table; check clearance on the real cell before moving there.
